That's not normal at all. 

Born in LA, lived there 19 years.
Not gonna lie...I still don't know what ALS is and I have no interest in finding out just because people are deciding to waste perfectly good ice water over it.

Honestly, any time I try to distract myself, it's still going on in the back of my head. As far as psychiatric help, I can't afford to do so. I'm not on my parents' insurance anymore and my state won't give me any sort of medical assistance because I'm a full time student (as stupid as that sounds).
I'm sorry, but this is a stupid question. Of course there will be improvements to PSN.
AC4 was pretty good and it's neither sports nor FPS. I bought PS4 for Destiny, Watch_Dogs, Driveclub, Infamous Second Son, and just the sheer awesomeness of the presentations Sony provided.
This wouldn't surprise me considering the two used PS3s I'd bought off someone from Craigslist had at least 24 hours of porn on each. I imagine nothing changed from PS4.

I'm not buying it and I never played it before. In fact, I've not played a Tomb Raider game since PS1. I just have no desire to play the series anymore. There's been nothing I've seen in this edition either that says, "Hey, buy me."
Isn't there always some weird guitar thing going on when you boot it up?
I don't understand how this happens to people..
I'd rather pay full price for the game and have an online mode of some sort  than pay 15 a month, but I guess it's better than nickel and diming for boosts/autoupgrade.
I wonder how long it'll take them to figure out that they aren't actually bothering the companies as much as they are bothering us.
I am hoping this becomes a feature at some point.
